reference_control.reason: CSS Inline 3 sections 4.1 and 4.2.2 align corresponding text-over baselines for inherited dominant-baseline:text-top and alignment-baseline:baseline. Chromium 152 rejects both dominant-baseline:text-top and the upstream reference alignment-baseline:text-top. This fixture has only single-line undecorated spans with line-height:1, so vertical-align:text-top on every span supplies the same text-over alignment through the supported shorthand, including synthesized orthogonal atomic baselines.
